class_loans_closed_fields_consistent.name: class_loans_closed_fields_consistent
class_loans_closed_fields_consistent.value:
("class_loans"."status" = 'closed' and "class_loans"."closed_at" is not null and "class_loans"."closed_by_user_id" is not null)
        or ("class_loans"."status" != 'closed' and "class_loans"."closed_at" is null and "class_loans"."closed_by_user_id" is null)

class_years_closed_date_consistent.name: class_years_closed_date_consistent
class_years_closed_date_consistent.value:
("class_years"."status" = 'closed' and "class_years"."actual_closed_date" is not null)
        or ("class_years"."status" != 'closed' and "class_years"."actual_closed_date" is null)

inventory_transactions_reversal_consiste.name: inventory_transactions_reversal_consistent
inventory_transactions_reversal_consiste.value:
("inventory_transactions"."kind" = 'reversal' and "inventory_transactions"."reversal_of_id" is not null)
        or ("inventory_transactions"."kind" != 'reversal' and "inventory_transactions"."reversal_of_id" is null)

inventory_transactions_loan_consistent.name: inventory_transactions_loan_consistent
inventory_transactions_loan_consistent.value: "inventory_transactions"."kind" not in ('loan_issue', 'loan_return') or "inventory_transactions"."loan_id" is not null

loans_closed_fields_consistent.name: loans_closed_fields_consistent
loans_closed_fields_consistent.value:
("loans"."status" = 'closed' and "loans"."closed_at" is not null and "loans"."closed_by_user_id" is not null)
        or ("loans"."status" != 'closed' and "loans"."closed_at" is null and "loans"."closed_by_user_id" is null)

material_cover_assets_location_valid.name: material_cover_assets_location_valid
material_cover_assets_location_valid.value:
(
        "material_cover_assets"."storage_provider" = 'r2'
        and "material_cover_assets"."storage_key" is not null
        and length(trim("material_cover_assets"."storage_key")) > 0
      ) or (
        "material_cover_assets"."storage_provider" = 'external'
        and ("material_cover_assets"."external_url" glob 'https://*' or "material_cover_assets"."external_url" glob 'http://*')
      )

material_cover_assets_dimensions_valid.name: material_cover_assets_dimensions_valid
material_cover_assets_dimensions_valid.value:
("material_cover_assets"."width" is null or "material_cover_assets"."width" > 0)
        and ("material_cover_assets"."height" is null or "material_cover_assets"."height" > 0)
        and ("material_cover_assets"."byte_length" is null or "material_cover_assets"."byte_length" >= 0)

material_cover_assets_sha256_valid.name: material_cover_assets_sha256_valid
material_cover_assets_sha256_valid.value:
"material_cover_assets"."sha256" is null or (
        length("material_cover_assets"."sha256") = 64
        and lower("material_cover_assets"."sha256") not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      )

material_request_events_actor_consistent.name: material_request_events_actor_consistent
material_request_events_actor_consistent.value:
("material_request_events"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "material_request_events"."actor_user_id" is null)
      or ("material_request_events"."actor_kind" in ('teacher','librarian') and "material_request_events"."actor_user_id" is not null)

material_request_items_quantity_valid.name: material_request_items_quantity_valid
material_request_items_quantity_valid.value:
"material_request_items"."requested_quantity" > 0
      and ("material_request_items"."approved_quantity" is null or ("material_request_items"."approved_quantity" >= 0 and "material_request_items"."approved_quantity" <= "material_request_items"."requested_quantity"))
      and "material_request_items"."fulfilled_quantity" >= 0
      and ("material_request_items"."approved_quantity" is null or "material_request_items"."fulfilled_quantity" <= "material_request_items"."approved_quantity")

material_requests_terminal_times.name: material_requests_terminal_times
material_requests_terminal_times.value:
("material_requests"."status" not in ('ready','partially_ready','completed') or ("material_requests"."ready_at" is not null and "material_requests"."pickup_location_id" is not null))
      and ("material_requests"."status" != 'completed' or "material_requests"."completed_at" is not null)
      and ("material_requests"."status" != 'rejected' or "material_requests"."rejected_at" is not null)
      and ("material_requests"."status" != 'cancelled' or "material_requests"."cancelled_at" is not null)

materials_class_range_valid.name: materials_class_range_valid
materials_class_range_valid.value:
(
        "materials"."class_from" is null and "materials"."class_to" is null
      ) or (
        "materials"."class_from" between 1 and 11
        and "materials"."class_to" between 1 and 11
        and "materials"."class_from" <= "materials"."class_to"
      )

mutation_commands_completion_consistent.name: mutation_commands_completion_consistent
mutation_commands_completion_consistent.value:
("mutation_commands"."status" = 'processing' and "mutation_commands"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("mutation_commands"."status" in ('completed', 'failed') and "mutation_commands"."completed_at" is not null)

teacher_profiles_closed_fields_consisten.name: teacher_profiles_closed_fields_consistent
teacher_profiles_closed_fields_consisten.value:
("teacher_profiles"."closed_at" is null and "teacher_profiles"."closed_by_user_id" is null)
        or ("teacher_profiles"."closed_at" is not null and "teacher_profiles"."closed_by_user_id" is not null)

visit_bookings_owner_valid.name: visit_bookings_owner_valid
visit_bookings_owner_valid.value:
("visit_bookings"."owner_kind" = 'teacher' and "visit_bookings"."owner_user_id" is not null
          and "visit_bookings"."owner_auth_user_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."owner_email" is null
          and "visit_bookings"."guest_owner_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."selected_teacher_user_id" is null)
        or ("visit_bookings"."owner_kind" = 'guest' and "visit_bookings"."owner_user_id" is null
          and "visit_bookings"."owner_auth_user_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."owner_email" is null
          and "visit_bookings"."guest_owner_id" is not null and "visit_bookings"."selected_teacher_user_id" is not null)
        or ("visit_bookings"."owner_kind" = 'legacy' and "visit_bookings"."owner_user_id" is null
          and length(trim("visit_bookings"."owner_auth_user_id")) > 0 and length(trim("visit_bookings"."owner_email")) > 0
          and "visit_bookings"."guest_owner_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."selected_teacher_user_id" is null)

visit_bookings_time_valid.name: visit_bookings_time_valid
visit_bookings_time_valid.value:
"visit_bookings"."start_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and "visit_bookings"."end_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and cast(substr("visit_bookings"."start_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_bookings"."end_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_bookings"."start_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and cast(substr("visit_bookings"."end_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and "visit_bookings"."start_time" < "visit_bookings"."end_time"

visit_bookings_cancel_consistent.name: visit_bookings_cancel_consistent
visit_bookings_cancel_consistent.value:
("visit_bookings"."status" = 'active' and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_at" is null
          and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_auth_user_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null
          and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_guest_owner_id" is null)
        or ("visit_bookings"."status" = 'cancelled' and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null
          and (("visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_auth_user_id" is not null and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null
              and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_guest_owner_id" is null)
            or ("visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_auth_user_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null
              and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_guest_owner_id" is null)
            or ("visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_auth_user_id" is null and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null
              and "visit_bookings"."cancelled_by_guest_owner_id" is not null)))

visit_commands_completion_consistent.name: visit_commands_completion_consistent
visit_commands_completion_consistent.value:
("visit_mutation_commands"."status" = 'processing' and "visit_mutation_commands"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("visit_mutation_commands"."status" in ('completed', 'failed') and "visit_mutation_commands"."completed_at" is not null)

visit_closures_time_valid.name: visit_closures_time_valid
visit_closures_time_valid.value:
"visit_schedule_closures"."start_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and "visit_schedule_closures"."end_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_closures"."start_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_closures"."end_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_closures"."start_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_closures"."end_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and "visit_schedule_closures"."start_time" < "visit_schedule_closures"."end_time"

visit_closures_cancel_consistent.name: visit_closures_cancel_consistent
visit_closures_cancel_consistent.value:
("visit_schedule_closures"."status" = 'active' and "visit_schedule_closures"."cancelled_at" is null and "visit_schedule_closures"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null)
        or ("visit_schedule_closures"."status" = 'cancelled' and "visit_schedule_closures"."cancelled_at" is not null and "visit_schedule_closures"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null)

visit_hours_time_valid.name: visit_hours_time_valid
visit_hours_time_valid.value:
"visit_schedule_hours"."start_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and "visit_schedule_hours"."end_time" glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_hours"."start_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_hours"."end_time", 1, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_hours"."start_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and cast(substr("visit_schedule_hours"."end_time", 4, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0
        and "visit_schedule_hours"."start_time" < "visit_schedule_hours"."end_time"

visit_slot_claims_exactly_one_owner.name: visit_slot_claims_exactly_one_owner
visit_slot_claims_exactly_one_owner.value:
("visit_slot_claims"."booking_id" is not null and "visit_slot_claims"."closure_id" is null)
        or ("visit_slot_claims"."booking_id" is null and "visit_slot_claims"."closure_id" is not null)

visit_slot_claims_key_valid.name: visit_slot_claims_key_valid
visit_slot_claims_key_valid.value:
length("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key") = 16
        and substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 1, 10) glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]'
        and substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 11, 1) = 'T'
        and substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 12, 5) glob '[0-9][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
        and date(substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 1, 10), '+0 days') = substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 1, 10)
        and cast(substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 12, 2) as integer) between 0 and 23
        and cast(substr("visit_slot_claims"."segment_key", 15, 2) as integer) % 5 = 0

visit_teacher_access_commands_completion.name: visit_teacher_access_commands_completion_consistent
visit_teacher_access_commands_completion.value: ("visit_teacher_access_commands"."status" = 'processing' and "visit_teacher_access_commands"."completed_at" is null) or ("visit_teacher_access_commands"."status" in ('completed', 'failed') and "visit_teacher_access_commands"."completed_at" is not null)
